'''Amino acids''' were molecules that served as the building blocks of [[Protein/Legends|proteins]].

{{Science-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Amino acids first appeared in the [[1983]] novel ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka]]'', written by [[L. Neil Smith]].
